space: Cosine per (observation, seed) over the (64, 7) action chunk in normalized action space (dataset_stats.json min/max to [-1, 1]); MAE against ground truth in real action units over the valid ground-truth rows. References: official ImageWAM bf16 and FlashRT fp16, both stored in the fixture. Every run starts from the fixture's fixed N(0,1) initial noise (the official sampler's per-seed draw), not the served 0.01 * N(0,1) draw (issues.md ISSUE-002). The fp16 reference carries the fixture's own text_trim (the manifest field; absent means untrimmed), and the gate refuses a configuration whose text_trim differs from it (issues.md ISSUE-080), so the vs_fp16_reference_* bounds always compare like for like: a trimmed configuration against a reference recorded trimmed, an untrimmed one against an untrimmed reference, with the same bounds either way.

fp16.note: H100 end-to-end baseline for fp16 vs official on fixture v1, whose reference is untrimmed: median 0.99840, min 0.99567, mean MAE 0.18359 (issues.md ISSUE-002). The fp16 reference is generated on H100; on another device this check measures cross-device drift of the same math. The same bounds apply to a trimmed fixture (imagewam_libero_gate_v2): its reference is recorded trimmed, so the comparison is the same like-for-like one. A trimmed run against the untrimmed v1 reference is not measured: it reads 0.99837 / 0.99579 cosine with mean MAE ratio 1.0115 rather than the precision's own error (issues.md ISSUE-080), which is why the manifest check refuses that combination.

nvfp4.note: Provisional until the first Thor gate run. Thor evidence: nvfp4 vs fp16 action cosine 0.9998 on one real frame, open-loop MAE 1.01x fp16 over 50 frames (opportunities.md OPT-014).

fp8_static.note: Gated only with a real activation-calibration file (IMAGEWAM_FP8_CALIBRATION or --fp8-calibration). With the N(0, 0.1) placeholder calibration, fp8_static reached backbone_hidden cosine ~0.46 on Thor (opportunities.md OPT-014), so it is never gated without one. Same bounds as nvfp4, the precision it would replace.

e0m3_hadamard.note: Same bounds as nvfp4: e0m3_hadamard is the other block-scaled 4-bit tier, and the eccf14f round measured it at or above nvfp4 on libero_spatial (vs official median 0.99786 default / 0.99968 stacked, against nvfp4's 0.99744 gate median). The gate reported 'blocked' for this precision only because this entry did not exist.

fp8_static_cutlass.note: Same numbers as fp8_static, which it shares numerics with: fp8_static_cutlass is the same static-scale FP8 tier with the CUTLASS GEMM path instead of cuBLASLt. The gate looks a precision up by name, so without this entry a gate run at this precision reports 'no fidelity thresholds for precision'.
